name: B10-0077/2025 (Renew) – Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to fight Russian disinformation and false history that Russia uses to justify its war against Ukraine. It asks for better coordination, support for research and education, and a ban on Soviet and Nazi symbols. It also wants a special court to prosecute aggression against Ukraine. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- No law changes; the Parliament states its position and calls for action.
- Affects EU institutions, member states, schools, media and online platforms.
- Next: the text goes to EU bodies and member state governments; they decide whether to act.
